title: Repair CORRECTION13 evidence-authority defects: typed evidence-result dataclasses (CommandResult, EvidenceTransactionResult, RepositoryGateResult), fail-closed Ruff identity for non-empty Python range, complete top-level shard-layout schema enforcement, hermetic tmp_path test fixtures (no fixed /tmp paths), AST-based fixed-tmp-path detection, effective Ruff configuration binding with launcher hashes, Git command cardinality measured from the executed transcript, complete one-transaction immutable bundle (manifest, topology, gate-results, bundle-root, changed-paths.z, changed-python-paths.z, ruff-input-paths.z, ruff-scope.json, ruff-argv.json, tool-identities.json, commands.json, final-classification.md), and final classification derived from typed results (CORRECTION14)

scope.prior_checkpoint: ACT-K9B-VERIFIER-CORE-MIGRATION-AUDIT01-CORRECTION13 (PARTIAL_CHECKPOINT; F13=8f58a669, S13=03369514; both under rescue refs rescue/audit01-correction13-{f13,s13})

known_defects_in_cor13._classify_claim_unmeasured_pass: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence_writer.py _build_classification_rows() emits unconditional | CORRECTION12_RECOVERY | PASS | and | byte_safe_pathname_api | PASS | rows alongside rows constructed via _classify_claim(name, measured=True). Hardcoded PASS claims are not evidence. CORRECTION14 removes every _classify_claim(...) call with measured=True and every direct unmeasured 'PASS' row; every PASS row must be derived from a typed EvidenceTransactionResult / RepositoryGateResult.
known_defects_in_cor13.ruff_skip_unresolved_identity_treated_as: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence.py collect_range_evidence treats ruff_invocation_mode='unresolved' as a SUCCESSFUL skip status ('skipped_unresolved_identity'). A non-empty Python range with an unresolved Ruff identity MUST fail closed (no manifest, no classification, no final destination, nonzero exit). CORRECTION14 removes 'skipped_unresolved_identity' as a publication status and raises RuffToolUnavailable when the Python range is non-empty and the identity cannot be resolved.
known_defects_in_cor13.shard_layout_partial_enforcement: scripts/verifiers_audit/scope.py _validate_shard_path_against_layout checks ONE shard at a time and only validates shards that already have a 'path' key. The CORRECTION14 contract enforces the COMPLETE top-level shard-layout schema BEFORE normalisation: required shards must be present, must be a dict, must contain a string path, and must identify exactly layout.shard_root / f'{name}.json'. Path traversal, swapped paths, symlink aliases, and extra unknown shards are rejected.
known_defects_in_cor13.fixed_shared_tmp_paths_in_tests: tests/verifiers/test_verifier_core_migration_audit01_correction13.py lines 248, 273, 298 build the empty-repo / subject-fail / runtimeerr fixtures under Path(os.fsdecode(os.fsencode('/tmp'))) / 'cor13-...'. A fixed shared /tmp path defeats parallel-safe, interrupted-run-safe testing. CORRECTION14 replaces every constructed /tmp path with pytest's tmp_path fixture and upgrades the source guard to AST-based detection that catches absolute Path(...) calls, encode/decode wrappers, tempfile with fixed directories, and /var/tmp / platform equivalents.
known_defects_in_cor13.ruff_configuration_binding_is_just_filen: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence_identity.py resolve_ruff_identity appends the first three candidate filenames (pyproject.toml / ruff.toml / .ruff.toml) to configuration_files regardless of whether Ruff actually reads them, and never resolves the effective closest config for every input path. CORRECTION14 prefers an explicit --config invocation when the config is canonical; otherwise resolves the closest config for every Ruff input path (and every extend dependency) and records their SHA-256 hashes. The launcher prefix, launcher path, launcher SHA-256, ruff_version, and the EXACT executed argv are bound.
known_defects_in_cor13.git_command_cardinality_from_wrapper_not: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence.py counts git calls via a single shared _run_captured wrapper and uses the wrapper's call count as authority for the 'git_diff_query_count == 1' claim. CORRECTION14 injects one explicit GitRunner command seam (Protocol with run(argv, *, cwd) -> CommandResult), records the actual transcript, and derives the cardinality from the executed argv (argv[:2] == ('git', 'diff')).
known_defects_in_cor13.bundle_publishes_before_gate_results: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence.py writes manifest.json, ruff-scope.json, ruff-argv.json, tool-identities.json, commands.json, changed-paths.z, etc. BEFORE running the post-subject gates. gate-results.json is not produced inside the same transaction and is not hashed into a bundle-root.json. CORRECTION14 produces a complete detached bundle in ONE transaction: manifest.json, topology.txt, gate-results.json (containing the post-subject gate commands and results), changed-paths.z, changed-python-paths.z, ruff-input-paths.z, ruff-scope.json, ruff-argv.json, tool-identities.json, commands.json, final-classification.md, bundle-root.json. bundle-root.json hashes every other final artifact and binds F14, F14_tree, plan_blob, S14, S14_tree, parent_F14, parent_S14, files (relpath -> sha256).
known_defects_in_cor13.final_classification_uses_rendered_strin: scripts/verifiers_audit/range_evidence_writer.py _build_classification_rows builds a list of (signal, value) string rows; the values are typed-in strings, not derived from a typed result object. CORRECTION14 introduces typed CommandResult, EvidenceTransactionResult, RepositoryGateResult dataclasses; the renderer accepts the typed results and renders every claim from the typed measurement (or UNMEASURED / FAILED).

typed_evidence_results.CommandResult: @dataclass(frozen=True) class CommandResult: argv: tuple[str, ...]; returncode: int; stdout_sha256: str; stderr_sha256: str; status: Literal['passed', 'failed', 'skipped'].
typed_evidence_results.EvidenceTransactionResult: @dataclass(frozen=True) class EvidenceTransactionResult: base_oid: str; subject_oid: str; git_commands: tuple[CommandResult, ...]; ruff_result: CommandResult | None; publication_status: Literal['ready_to_publish', 'published', 'failed']; authoritative_hashes: Mapping[str, str].
typed_evidence_results.RepositoryGateResult: @dataclass(frozen=True) class RepositoryGateResult: name: str; argv: tuple[str, ...]; returncode: int; stdout_sha256: str; stderr_sha256: str.
typed_evidence_results.renderer_invariant: The renderer may only derive 'PASS' when the corresponding typed result proves success (status='passed', returncode==0, hashes match authoritative_hashes). An absent or unknown measurement renders 'UNMEASURED' or 'FAILED', never 'PASS'.
deleted_patterns: literal 'PASS' rows that have no typed measurement

fail_closed_ruff_for_nonempty_python_ran.new_typed_failure: class RuffToolUnavailable(RuntimeError): raised when the Python path tuple is non-empty AND resolve_ruff_identity returns None AND the venv python interpreter cannot import ruff.
fail_closed_ruff_for_nonempty_python_ran.behaviour: For a non-empty python_paths tuple, the producer MUST raise RuffToolUnavailable when resolve_ruff_identity returns None. The function refuses to invoke Ruff; the producer exits nonzero; the staging directory is removed; no final destination is created; no manifest, no classification.
fail_closed_ruff_for_nonempty_python_ran.removed_publication_status: skipped_unresolved_identity is REMOVED as a successful publication status. The empty-python-range case still records status='skipped_no_python_paths' with exit_code=0 and ruff_not_invoked=True.
required_tests: .venv python present but ruff import fails
non-empty range fails closed in every case
empty range still records its explicit valid skip

complete_shard_layout_schema.goal: Before normalising ANY shard path, enforce the complete top-level shard-layout schema.
complete_shard_layout_schema.ordering: Required BEFORE per-shard validation: index['shards'] must be a dict; set(index['shards']) MUST equal REQUIRED_SHARDS (no missing shard, no extra unknown shard).
complete_shard_layout_schema.path_constraint: info['path'] MUST be a string; MUST identify exactly layout.shard_root / f'{shard_name}.json' (no symlink alias accepted merely because Path.resolve() reaches the target); MUST NOT escape layout.shard_root; MUST NOT be a swapped path (inventory on groups, etc.).
complete_shard_layout_schema.symlink_alias_rejection: Do NOT accept a symlink alias merely because Path.resolve() reaches the expected target. Use lexical containment (posixpath.commonpath) AND an explicit symlink check (Path.is_symlink) on every shard path. A symlink alias that reaches the canonical shard path is REJECTED.

tmp_path_hermeticity.replacement: Every constructed /tmp path in the test suite is replaced with pytest's tmp_path fixture (already hermetic, parallel-safe, interrupted-run-safe).
tmp_path_hermeticity.deleted_pattern: Path(os.fsdecode(os.fsencode('/tmp'))) / ... is REMOVED from every test.
tmp_path_hermeticity.ast_source_guard_upgrade: The source guard in tests/verifiers/verifier_core_migration_audit01_support.py audit01_source_guard_violations() upgrades fixed-tmp detection to AST-based scanning. It MUST detect: absolute Path(...) calls with a string literal starting with '/' (any platform path component); constant-folding wrappers around absolute paths; encode/decode wrappers around absolute paths; tempfile.* calls with a fixed shared directory; explicit /var/tmp and platform equivalents.

effective_ruff_configuration.explicit_config_strategy: When an explicit --config can represent the repository policy (pyproject.toml present at REPO_ROOT and resolves the entire config chain), the producer invokes <launcher-prefix> check --config <canonical-config> <paths...>.
effective_ruff_configuration.fallback_strategy: When explicit --config cannot represent the policy (e.g. extend dependencies), the producer resolves the effective closest config for every input path and every extend dependency and records each config_path / config_sha256.
effective_ruff_configuration.do_not_label_inspection_as_binding: Do NOT claim ruff_configuration_hashes_bound merely because three root-level candidate filenames were inspected. The record MUST contain the actual config_path / config_sha256 of the file Ruff consulted, plus the launcher_sha256 of the executable.

git_command_cardinality.injected_command_seam: class GitRunner(Protocol): def run(self, argv: tuple[str, ...], *, cwd: Path) -> CommandResult: ... The producer invokes the seam exactly ONCE per git execution; the seam records the executed argv verbatim.
git_command_cardinality.cardinality_source: git_diff_query_count = sum(result.argv[:2] == ('git', 'diff') for result in git_results). The cardinality is derived from the executed transcript, NOT from a wrapper call count.

complete_immutable_bundle.transactional_producer: The producer creates every final artifact in ONE staging transaction. The staging directory may be renamed to the final destination only after the complete bundle (manifest, topology, gate-results, every .z, every .json, final-classification, bundle-root) is present and validated.
complete_immutable_bundle.gate_results: gate-results.json contains the captured post-subject gate commands and results. It is added DURING the bundle production (NOT manually after publication). Each row records: name, argv, cwd, exit_code, stdout_sha256, stderr_sha256.
complete_immutable_bundle.bundle_root_invariant: bundle-root.json hashes every other final artifact (relpath -> sha256) and binds: F14, F14_tree, plan_blob, S14, S14_tree, parent_F14, parent_S14, files (relpath -> sha256).
complete_immutable_bundle.immutability: After publication, no command may modify the bundle. A test hashes the complete directory BEFORE and AFTER every subsequent reporting step and proves the root hash remains unchanged.
complete_immutable_bundle.post_publication_test: A test hashes the complete directory, attempts every subsequent reporting step (e.g. re-writing manifest, re-running gate), and proves the bundle-root hash remains unchanged.
complete_immutable_bundle.topology_production: topology.txt is produced transactionally with the bundle. It records the Phase 0 topology (F14, F14_tree, plan_blob, parent_F14, S14, S14_tree, parent_S14, rescue branches).

actual_classification_derivation.ruff_identity: pass_when: ruff_result.status == 'passed'; executed_argv starts with recorded launcher prefix; launcher_sha256 is present and matches the recorded launcher path.
actual_classification_derivation.cmd_check_contract: pass_when: a named RepositoryGateResult exists for cmd_check; returncode == 0; stdout/stderr hashes match gate-results.json.
actual_classification_derivation.publication: pass_when: complete staging validation passed; final rename succeeded; bundle-root validation passed; no command modified the bundle after publication.
actual_classification_derivation.unknown_or_absent: rendered as UNMEASURED or FAILED, never PASS.
